test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: The correct answer is '**plans**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given passage is about Dr. Jill Biden: First Lady. • In the fourth blank 'plans' should be used. • It means 'an idea or arrangement for doing or achieving something in the future'. [योजना, विचार (किसी काम या कुछ करने के लिए)] • *Example: make our holiday **plan**...* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **aim**: something that you intend to do; a purpose. (लक्ष्‍य, उद्देश्‍य; अभिप्राय) • **think**: to have a particular idea or opinion about something/somebody; to believe. [किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के विषय में विशेष विचार या मत रखना; (कुछ) मानना] • **plot**: the series of events which form the story of a novel, film, etc. (नाटक या उपन्‍यास का कथानक, कथावस्‍तु) • Thus, as per the above definitions, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3.** Correct Passage:__ *Dr. Jill Biden is an English professor in a college and she has four degrees, including a doctorate. She is the wife of the newly elected U.S. President, Joe Biden. As America's next first lady, the 69-year-old Jill Biden **plans** to keep her job and continue teaching (5)_______ is something that she did as the second lady when her husband was the Vice President.* 27e:T9b6, The correct answer is '**which**'.
